technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot's 'MODULE' layout configuration for the Gradle build option to resolve the scoping issue.
Implement batching for the Rabbit sink using Spring Integration's aggregator or similar batching mechanism, configurable via properties.
Apply the Strategy pattern or Spring's conditional configuration to allow users to override and customize compression defaults.
Make the database initialization in DIRT runtime conditional based on a profile or property flag to support stream-processing-only setups.
Define a clear Java interface contract for RxJava processor modules to seamlessly integrate with the Spring XD module lifecycle.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and Spring XD.
Continuous Integration (CI) infrastructure is already in place and supports adding new acceptance test suites.
Performance benchmarking tools, scripts, and previous baseline snapshots are available and accessible.
Test environments for RabbitMQ and HDFS are available for development and testing.
No new infrastructure setup is required, only software development and configuration.

activities.activity_description: Design, implement, and unit test the batching option for the Rabbit sink, allowing data to be written in batches instead of one-at-a-time (U1).

activities.activity_name: Create Gradle Build Option for Modules
activities.activity_description: Develop the Gradle build configuration to support module projects, declaring Spring XD dependencies as provided and configuring the Boot plugin for 'MODULE' layout (U2).
Write and integrate acceptance test coverage for the hdfs-dataset module to validate functionality as part of every CI build (U3).
Refactor compression implementation to allow overriding defaults and customizing compression strategies as needed (U4).
Setup, execute, and analyze baseline benchmarks with batching enabled on Rabbit (batchingEnabled=true, batchingSize=100) to compare with previous snapshots (U5).
Setup, execute, and analyze baseline benchmarks with compression enabled on Rabbit to compare with previous snapshots (U6).
Implement and test an option to disable the database requirement so that the DIRT runtime can be used when only stream processing is required (U7).
Design and implement the core interface contract to allow the creation of processor modules that use the RxJava API (U8).
